'''Talak''' was a [[Reigat]] bruiser who worked on a [[Meleenium/Legends|meleenium]] heist on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] mines located in [[Qua'Tahc]], the capital of [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]].

==Biography==
Talak was believed to have previously frequented [[Malthor]]. [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] believed he resided in Fabrillan for some time before deciding to hire out his considerable strength and combat abilities. It was known for certain the Reigat moved from job to job, and that he eventually found himself in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], where he worked for some of the various underworld elements. His stay in there lasted nearly three years.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

During that time, Talak made acquaintance with the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rani Quanic]]. After Quanic reappeared on the Minos scene (following some time in prison) looking for accomplices in a recently-devised heist, Talak and his most recent partner, the [[Lowen]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] [[Ostan Atur]], agreed to accompany her.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

His "protecting" the thieves who made away with the Qua'Tahc mines shipment brought him trouble with New Republic law enforcement agencies. During the raid, the trio was pursued by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] security operatives. While Quanic secured the escape craft and loaded the stolen meleenium, Atur covered with heavy fire from the craft's gun emplacements and Talak dealt with them while engaging all three in a fierce brawl, seriously wounding [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Oollj]] and the [[Ug'Ggeran]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Cith Sninif]]. Only [[Kichiir]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] member of the elite [[Lightning Tech Squadron]] of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[Eclipse Team]], was able to match the Reigat's immense size and strength. But with the combined ferocity of Talak's attack and the constant cover provided by Atur's guns, even Kichiir was beaten. Before reinforcements could be called, Talak rushed back to the ''[[Lathien Leth]]'' and the thieving trio fled the [[Ka'Dedus system/Legends|Ka'Dedus system]] with 100 kilograms of meleenium.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

==Personality and traits==
Talak was something of a departure from the normal Reigat. Whereas most of them were solitary individuals, he, though not overly social, was known to work with others. He thoroughly enjoyed his occupation and became increasingly overconfident of his abilities, especially after defeating Kichiir. According to [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]], Talak was generally a high-profile character, as he enjoyed drawing attention to himself and his physical prowess, and that his image of himself further inflated since his "victory" against the Wookiee, which could possibly lead him to make a mistake and be apprehended.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

==Powers and abilities==
Talak had considerable skill in brawling parry and melee combat and parry, complemented further his advanced abilities in climbing and jumping and his stamina. Furthermore, he was able to match a Wookiee's strength and use the natural intimidation that many species felt towards the Reigat to his advantage.<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />

Due to his reliance on strength, he only carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWAJ10:WBC" />
